decoded.meaning: SUBSCRIBER{ SETTINGS{ NAME "delivery_policy" VALUE u16=0x0020 } } — no target_path child. Written to `:subscribers[N]` it is NOT an unsubscribe: it answers tr::schema::type_mismatch (0x0030) and slot N keeps its edge (RFC-0009 erratum 2026-10-08)
decoded.note: an implementation that clears slot N on this record fails the vector, and so does one that replaces the edge with a targetless one. The one slot-clear sentinel is the empty STATUS (framing/empty-status-ok)
